guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML, native controls, focus management, live regions for async output; applied via role=status aria-live status line, native buttons/labels, aria-pressed toggle, and a polite live region on the streaming output.

guidanceConsulted.query: keep INP low off main thread web worker streaming tokens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep heavy work off the main thread and avoid long tasks; applied by running the full decode loop in the worker and only appending streamed tokens on the main thread.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible progress status and live-region announcements for a long-running local model run, plus streaming token rate readout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve accessibility (search similarity 0.4943): announce dynamic errors via live regions, but centralise them — 'a single polite region and a single assertive region per page… too many regions, or noisy ones, quickly become spam'. Applied: <model-run-status> is now the ONE polite announcer for a run (start phase, completion with the real token count and average rate, failures, heartbeats); this page's #status keeps its visible text but no longer carries role=status/aria-live, so the same outcome is not announced twice. Supersedes the earlier guidanceConsulted entry on this route that cited 'role=status aria-live status line' as the announcement mechanism — that mechanism is what this change removes. Verified live-region count per page before/after in reports/token-counters-qho.json.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible progress status and live-region announcements for a long-running local model run, plus streaming token rate readout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve performance (search similarity 0.4493): keep hot streaming paths off layout work. Applied by design and unchanged here — the per-chunk token() call stores only the count and timestamp without touching the DOM, and the component repaints at most four times per second in tick(), so streaming does not invalidate layout per chunk. codegen-350m-multi shows the real generated-token count instead of the decoded-text-chunk count.

guidanceConsulted.query: keep native select and textarea controls inside a narrow mobile flex or grid container without clipped inputs or viewport expansion
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: modern-web-guidance@latest search (forms family, similarity 0.5182) and retrieve: 'It is recommended to set a max-inline-size (or max-width) on <select> elements… to ensure that extremely long selected options do not break the page layout', plus the companion warning that a minimum size must be kept 'to prevent the input from collapsing to a width of zero when empty (making it unclickable)'. APPLIED: the shared stylesheet now caps every input/textarea/select at max-inline-size: 100% and lets it shrink (min-inline-size: 0), and the codegen .controls label flex-wraps with min/max-inline-size constraints, so the select's intrinsic min-content width can no longer widen the document — at a requested 360px these pages previously rendered into 404px. The controls stay inside their container rather than being clipped, and they are never width-0 because their grid/flex container supplies the width (verified: every control measured with a positive width in the 16-cell structural check).

guidanceConsulted.query: keep native select and textarea controls inside a narrow mobile flex or grid container without clipped inputs or viewport expansion
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve overflow-clipping-control — CONSULTED AND DELIBERATELY NOT APPLIED. The guide covers overflow: clip with overflow-clip-margin for containing child paint; clipping is the wrong instrument for this defect because it would hide the overflowing control instead of letting it fit (and the guide's own framing is about shadow/bleed containment, not layout sizing). The fix therefore constrains the control's inline size, preserving native picker behaviour and leaving the panel's overflow untouched.
